reading.title: How do we learn languages?
reading.text: Young children acquire their first language without formal lessons. A major inquiry by linguists, based on an online questionnaire completed by around 670,000 people, suggested that the ability to learn grammar perfectly declines after about the age of 17. This does not mean adults cannot learn: it simply requires more time and effort. Many adult learners, the researchers found, conquer their difficulties by using the language every day rather than only in class.
